### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **18897****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **09/28/2026**


### **We Are**Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

  

  

### **You Are**


You have spent the last few years building AI systems that actually ship, not just prototypes that look good in a slide deck. You know the difference between a demo that impresses in a meeting and a production system that runs reliably at 3 AM when no one is watching. You understand that the hard part is not getting an LLM to respond, it is building the orchestration, memory, retrieval, and guardrails that make it work consistently across real workflows.


You are comfortable moving between agent frameworks, backend services, and user\-facing components without losing sight of what you are actually solving. When a multi\-step workflow fails, you do not just retry it, you trace the state, check the memory, review the tool calls, and figure out what broke three steps earlier. You think in systems, not scripts.


You care about the details that make AI applications reliable: evaluation frameworks that catch hallucinations, observability that surfaces why an agent chose a particular path, memory architectures that actually remember what matters. You do not wait for perfect requirements. You ask the right questions, build something that works, and iterate based on what you learn.


At Synopsys, you will work on agentic AI systems that directly impact how engineering teams design chips and build the technology that powers everything from autonomous vehicles to machine learning hardware.

  

  

### **What You'll Be Doing**


* Design, build, test, and deploy agentic AI applications using ADK, NAT, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, and OpenCode to create workflow\-driven systems that handle planning, reasoning, task decomposition, and multi\-step orchestration
* Implement and optimize agent memory systems including semantic, procedural, episodic, working, session, and long\-term memory with consolidation and retrieval strategies that make agents actually remember context across conversations
* Build RAG pipelines that combine embeddings, vector search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and contextual grounding to ground agent responses in real enterprise knowledge bases and documentation
* Integrate agents with enterprise APIs, tools, databases, and search systems using function calling, tool calling, MCP, and connector patterns that make external services accessible to LLM\-driven workflows
* Develop backend services, orchestration layers, REST APIs, and user\-facing components including human\-in\-the\-loop experiences and operational dashboards that give users visibility and control
* Build automated evaluation frameworks that measure answer quality, memory relevance, tool\-use success, trajectory quality, hallucination rates, latency, cost, and safety across production workloads
* Implement observability through tracing, structured logging, prompt versioning, model tracking, workflow telemetry, and incident analysis so you can diagnose failures and improve system behavior over time
  

  

### **The Impact You Will Have**


* Accelerate how Synopsys IP design teams work by delivering agentic AI systems that automate complex EDA workflows and reduce time spent on repetitive engineering tasks
* Build reliable AI applications that combine LLMs, tools, memory, and retrieval into production systems that engineering teams trust and depend on daily
* Establish reusable patterns, components, and engineering practices that make it faster for other teams to build and ship their own AI\-enabled applications
* Improve the quality and safety of AI systems across Synopsys by implementing evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability that catch issues before they reach users
* Contribute to the technical maturity of the AI engineering team through code reviews, design discussions, mentorship, and knowledge sharing that raises the bar for everyone
* Help position Synopsys as a leader in responsible, enterprise\-grade AI by building systems that balance capability with security, reliability, and ethical deployment
  

  

### **What You'll Need**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, or equivalent practical experience
* 2\+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems, with demonstrated experience delivering AI/ML, Generative AI, or agentic AI applications
* Strong proficiency in Python and working knowledge of at least one of JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C\+\+, or Go
* Hands\-on experience with one or more agentic frameworks such as ADK, NAT, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies
* Strong understanding of LLM application design, workflow orchestration, prompt engineering, tool and function calling, RAG and Hybrid Graph/RAG architectures, agent memory systems, and single\-agent and multi\-agent patterns
* Experience with vector databases, embeddings, search systems, reranking, and knowledge\-retrieval pipelines that power RAG and semantic search
* Experience building full\-stack AI applications including backend APIs or microservices and user\-facing AI experiences, plus experience testing and evaluating non\-deterministic AI systems, familiarity with AWS, GCP, or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Git\-based development, CI/CD, automated testing, and Agile practices, and understanding of AI observability, security, privacy, guardrails, and responsible AI principles are all strong pluses
  

  

### **Who You Are**


* You can take a vague product requirement and turn it into a working agentic workflow without needing someone to spell out every implementation detail
* You move fluidly between designing an agent's reasoning loop, debugging a memory retrieval issue, writing backend API code, and explaining a tradeoff to a product manager
* You write code that other engineers can read, maintain, and extend, and you care enough about engineering quality to push back when a shortcut will create problems three months from now
* You can explain why an agent chose a particular tool or how a memory system decides what to retain in a way that makes sense to both a senior architect and a designer building a user interface
* You are the kind of engineer who digs into production logs at 11 PM not because you have to, but because you want to understand why a workflow failed and how to prevent it next time

You treat AI systems with the same rigor you would* to any production software: you think about failure modes, edge cases, observability, security, and the humans who will depend on what you build
  

  

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


You will be part of Synopsys' effort to leverage Generative and Agentic AI to enhance the productivity of IP Design teams. The team is building agents and orchestration platforms that target EDA chip design flows, working at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI technology and the complex engineering workflows that power semiconductor development. You will collaborate with other engineers, product managers, designers, researchers, platform teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions that solve high\-value problems for engineering teams across the company.

  

  

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.


At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Lead Engineer, AI
description:
**About Us**
------------


Circle is building the world’s leading AI\-powered, all\-in\-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.


We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30\+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.


Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!


Check out our **Careers** page for more about working at Circle.

**About the role**
------------------


The AI Quality engineering team at Circle owns the foundation for measuring, diagnosing, and improving the quality of Circle's AI\-powered features. This team focuses on building the infrastructure to measure, diagnose, and improve production AI systems, rather than ML research or model training.


We're looking for a Lead Engineer to help us build out the evaluation frameworks, observability tooling, and diagnostic infrastructure that tell us whether our AI Agents are working well, where to improve them, and how to make them faster and more cost\-efficient.


This is a hands\-on player\-coach role. You’ll also lead and manage the AI Quality engineering team, with an ambitious and growing roadmap.


If you're excited about making AI systems work reliably, efficiently, and at scale, this is for you.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* **Build and own our evaluation infrastructure.** Design the CI/CD pipelines, scorers, and datasets that tell us whether Circle's AI agents (planners, tool\-callers, and sub\-agents) are actually working, from a single tool call to a full multi\-turn conversation.
* **Diagnose exactly where quality breaks down.** Trace failures across the agent pipeline including plan creation vs. execution, tool selection, tool trajectory in complex areas like workflows, site builder, and analytics. Turn what you find into prototypes that solve the issue or identify priorities for AI core engineering can help.
* **Grow the datasets that make evaluation possible.** Stand up annotation workflows and build out AI\-generated and simulated conversations so we can cover more of the product faster than manual labeling alone.
* **Run structured experiments across prompts, models, and the agent harness.** Evaluate new and open\-source models against our production baseline, build the framework we use to decide when to shift models, and chase cost and latency wins through model swaps, caching, and routing by plan complexity.
* **Lead and grow the AI Quality engineering team.** Set technical direction and manage day\-to\-day priorities, all while staying hands\-on in the code yourself.
* **Partner closely with AI Core engineering.** Work with the engineers building Circle's AI products so they have real confidence that their changes are actually improving quality, not just shipping.

**What you'll need to be successful**
-------------------------------------

* **7\+ years of experience building and shipping production software, ideally including LLM\-powered agents that take real actions in a product.** You've worked on complex, tool\-using systems (multiple tools, planning or orchestration, sub\-agents) not just simple, single\-turn assistants, and you can walk us through something you shipped and how you knew it was actually working.
* **Comfortable in Ruby on Rails / Python or ready to pick them up quickly.** Ruby on Rails is our production system and the foundation that Circle’s AI Agents are built on and proficiency in Python is a strong plus, especially for the data and evaluation side of the work.
* **Experience building evaluation or observability infrastructure for ML/AI systems.** You've built eval pipelines, scorers, dashboards, or CI/CD for evals before and have experience with evaluation frameworks like Braintrust, LangSmith, or similar.
* **Experience designing datasets, annotation workflows, or labeling pipelines for ML/AI evaluation.** You know how to turn raw examples into a dataset you can trust through human annotation, AI\-generated data, or simulation.
* **Learn fast, experiment aggressively, and thrive in a highly dynamic environment.** You’ll need to be comfortable running a lot of experiments and letting the results settle the argument, including the ones that don't work (which will be many of them in the beginning).
* **Comfortable in a fast\-paced environment with ambiguity.** You’ll need to learn and pick up new technologies when projects require it.
* **Strong alignment with** **our company values****.**
* You are proficient in English (spoken, written, and reading) at a **CEFR Level C2** / **ILR Level 5**.

  

**Compensation \& benefits**
----------------------------


Circle offers U.S.\-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year.


We’re a remote\-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub.

Your work directly supports the training and validation of machine learning models for Amazon Robotics and Fulfillment Technologies, ensuring the quality and integrity of data which is critical for frontier AI improvements. Your work will involve analyzing processes such as packaging innovation, object manipulation, inventory storage, and sortation automation within fulfillment environments. This role is offered on a contractual basis, with the opportunity to transition into a full\-time position based on performance and business requirements.  

Basic qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with 0\.6 \- 5 years of experience working with data transcription and annotation.

As Group Creative Director, you will be the creative conscience of the agency, setting the standard not just by assigning work, but by understanding the work deeply enough to unblock it when it matters most.



This is a role for someone who has earned their stripes in agency life, understands the full machinery of creative delivery, and whose hands\-on technical knowledge makes them a genuine resource to the people around them, not just a title above them.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


### **Be the Practical Problem\-Solver the Team Needs**


* When the team hits a wall, you're the one who knows how to climb it. Whether it's a design execution challenge, a production constraint, a motion problem, or an AI workflow that isn't behaving, you can step in with a real, working solution rather than a theoretical one
* Your value in those moments comes from having actually done the work at some point, knowing the tools, understanding the process, and being able to show rather than just tell
* Identify creative and technical blockers early, and resolve them before they become delays or compromises in quality
* Establish ways of working that give the team clarity, reduce friction, and raise the floor on output

### **Lead with Craft and Creative Authority**


* Set the visual and conceptual tone across campaigns, brands, and platforms
* Maintain a strong, consistent aesthetic point of view that elevates every piece of work that leaves the building
* Be the person in the room who can tell whether an idea is truly great, and articulate clearly and specifically why

### **Think Strategically, Create Deliberately**


* Partner with strategy and account leadership to develop creative briefs that are sharp, provocative, and genuinely useful
* Translate brand positioning, audience insight, and business objectives into creative territory that is both distinctive and effective
* Anticipate client needs before they are articulated. Read between the lines of a brief and pre\-empt creative pivots before they become problems

### **Scope, Plan, and Protect the Work**


* Bring a grounded understanding of what it actually takes to execute ideas well, and use that to scope workstreams realistically and responsibly
* Identify early where a project might hit friction, whether creative, technical, or logistical, and resolve it upstream
* Build timelines and resource plans that protect quality without sacrificing pace

### **Communicate with Clarity and Conviction**


* A sharp communicator both internally and externally, able to present ideas, navigate feedback, and align stakeholders with equal confidence
* A natural storyteller who can structure a narrative whether in a credentials deck, a pitch room, or an all\-hands. The kind of person whose presentations people actually remember
* Skilled at reading a room and knowing when to push, when to reframe, and when something simply isn't working yet. Able to have those honest conversations with tact and without ambiguity
* Rally creative teams around a vision and give them the kind of direction that is specific enough to act on

### **Build and Elevate the Creative Department**


* Mentor creative teams with specificity: not just what is wrong, but how to fix it and why it matters
* Create an environment where junior talent is challenged, developed, and retained
* Set the tone for creative culture: rigorous, curious, collaborative, and ambitious

### **Own the AI Creative Frontier**


* Be the agency's lead practitioner and evangelist for AI in creative work. Fluent in generative image, video, copy, and audio tools, and always current with the evolving landscape
* Go beyond generation: architect AI\-assisted workflows and production pipelines that meaningfully improve creative output, speed, and scale
* Identify where AI creates genuine creative opportunity versus where it compromises craft, and make those calls with authority
* Educate and upskill the creative department on AI tools, establishing shared standards for their ethical and effective use
* Collaborate with technology and production partners to design bespoke AI solutions for client challenges

**What You Bring**
------------------


### **Experience**


* 15\+ years in creative roles, with a significant portion spent in agency environments (integrated, digital, or brand)
* Proven experience leading creative departments or large multi\-disciplinary creative teams
* A portfolio that demonstrates range across brand, campaign, digital, and experiential, with a clear and ownable aesthetic sensibility
* Industry award recognition is a strong differentiator and speaks to a consistent standard of creative ambition. Shortlists, wins, and a culture of entering work are all signals we take seriously

### **Hard Skills and Technical Range**


* Genuine proficiency across the tools and disciplines relevant to modern creative production: design, art direction, motion, digital, and AI\-assisted workflows
* Enough technical depth in each area to diagnose problems, propose solutions, and demonstrate them when needed
* Not expected to execute every deliverable day\-to\-day, but absolutely expected to know how, and to use that knowledge to make the team sharper

### **Creative and Strategic Capability**


* A thinker and a maker in equal measure, able to move between strategic framework and craft\-level execution without losing quality at either end
* Strong design instincts and visual literacy, equally comfortable directing photography, motion, digital design, and emerging formats
* The ability to hold a brand truth and a big idea simultaneously, and translate both into work that resonates

### **AI Proficiency**


* Active, working knowledge of leading generative AI tools (image, video, language, audio): not surface\-level familiarity, but genuine hands\-on expertise
* Experience designing or implementing AI into creative and production workflows
* An informed, evolving perspective on where AI is heading and what it means for the creative industry

### **Communication and Storytelling**


* Exceptional presenter and communicator, comfortable in the boardroom, the pitch, and the internal critique with equal conviction
* A natural instinct for narrative: how to structure a story, build tension, land a point, and leave a room energised
* Direct, clear, and credible in the way they give feedback and manage expectations

**The Kind of Person You Are**
------------------------------


* You don't just have taste, you can articulate it. You don't just delegate, you demonstrate. You're not threatened by AI; you're ahead of it. You've sat in enough pitches to know when an idea is campaign\-ready and when it's still a sketch, and you're not afraid to say so clearly, even when it's uncomfortable.
* You know the difference between a production problem and a creative problem. You know when a brief is actually good. You've done the work yourself long enough to know exactly where teams get stuck, and you show up to those moments with practical answers, not just encouragement.
* You believe that craft and speed are not opposites. That strategy and beauty belong together. And that the best creative leaders are the ones still learning.

**Why This Role**
-----------------



This is a genuine leadership position with real creative authority, not a bureaucratic title. You'll work on brands that matter, alongside people who care deeply about what they make. The agency is at an inflection point, investing seriously in AI capability, new creative formats, and a more integrated way of working. You'll help define what that looks like.

Candidates must have personally configured Salesforce CPQ and must have practical, hands\-on experience building AI agents.

* **Quote\-to\-Cash Solution Design:** Map and optimize the end\-to\-end sales journey, covering account creation/validation, opportunity management, quote generation, contract finalization, and order confirmation.

Define the Salesforce and Informatica MDM integration for account validation, enrichment, and deduplication. This includes resolving conflicts between third\-party data (ZoomInfo, D\&B, SEC) and existing MDM records.
* **Data \& Technical Validation:** Write SOQL queries to analyze data models, troubleshoot configuration edge cases, and validate data migrations/enrichment pipelines.
* **AI \& Emerging Tech:** Assist in evaluating and setting up native AI capabilities (e.g., Salesforce Agentforce, sub\-agents) to automate internal workflows and user journeys.

* Experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud, or subscription\-first technology companies.

**Manager/Sr. Manager, Engineering \- AI Platform**

  

We are looking for a Manager/Senior Manager, Engineering for our AI Platform team. Someone who can take ownership of a fast\-growing, high\-visibility team building the agentic foundation for SimCorp One, and who is ready to help define how AI agents get built, governed, and shipped across the company.  



  

**WHAT MAKES US, US**

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!


At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — Caring, Customer success\-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.


If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!  



  

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

SimCorp's AI \& Insights area is building the foundation for the agentic future of investment operations: Running SimCorp agents, leveraging partner agents, and integrating with clients workflows. The AI Platform team owns that foundation: a compliant, standardized, secure, and user\-friendly agentic ecosystem that domain teams can leverage when building their AI features.


The team's recent deliveries and current focus include preparing Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo for production, publishing the Agent Development Stack, implementing evaluation, trust, safety and guardrails, progressing multi\-agent orchestration, and exploring MCP for SimCorp One APIs.


You will partner closely with the Product Manager for AI Platform to turn the roadmap into delivery, and you will report directly to the Senior Director of Engineering. You will also be part of the AI \& Insights leadership team, contributing to the broader deliveries and growth of the area.  



  

**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

  

**Team leadership and development**

* Lead and grow the AI Platform team, distributed across multiple locations, creating clear priorities and a supportive, engaged culture
* Develop individual engineers through regular 1:1s, coaching, and honest feedback
* Hire and onboard new engineers into an already fast\-moving workstream as scope grows

**Delivery and operations**

* Own delivery of the AI Platform roadmap: production readiness for Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo, the Agent Development Stack, evaluation/trust/safety/guardrails, multi\-agent orchestration, and MCP for SCD APIs
* Manage day\-to\-day prioritisation, capacity, and engineering health, keeping delivery and engagement strong
* Remove blockers before they slow the team down, and hold a high bar on security, compliance, and operational readiness

**Stakeholder and cross\-team collaboration**

* Partner with the Product Manager to translate product strategy into an executable engineering plan
* Align with the Senior Director of Engineering on priorities and risks
* Collaborate across Product Development, and translate technical work into clear updates for non\-technical stakeholders

**Strategy and growth**

* Help shape SimCorp's agentic platform strategy as scope expands beyond today's capabilities
* Anticipate where the team needs to grow in skills, headcount, and tooling, and advocate for it
Bring an informed point of view on responsible, safe, and governed AI agent development  
* 

  

**WHAT WE VALUE**

  

**Ownership and independence** You take responsibility without being told to, dig in when things are unclear, and are comfortable deciding with incomplete information and following through.


**Management experience** You have led engineering teams before, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context, with a genuine track record of accountability for team outcomes and engagement.


**Technical grounding in AI and platform engineering** You have a background in software or platform engineering and engage comfortably with agent orchestration, LLM\-based systems, APIs, and the trust/safety layer around them. You will not write production code, but you understand what your engineers build, ask the right questions, and spot when something is off.


**Communication clarity** You write and speak in plain, precise English, can explain a complex platform decision to a non\-technical stakeholder, and represent your team with confidence in senior forums.


**Result orientation and a growth mindset** You focus on outcomes, not just activity, and drive your own growth and your team's.


**Distributed team experience and empathy** Leading a distributed team takes clear communication, inclusive practices, and genuine attention to people's wellbeing. Experience with Scandinavian or European teams, and comfort with remote work, is a plus.


**Structured thinking in ambiguous situations** AI technology and the team's scope are still evolving. You create clarity, manage capacity with discipline, and align with stakeholders without escalating every decision.


**Collaborative by default** You know when to align, when to decide, and when to push back \- and do all three constructively, fitting naturally with how we work  



  

**BENEFITS**

* **Global hybrid work policy** \- We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* **Culture** – Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* **Work\-life balance** – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* **Empowerment** – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.
* **Career \& Growth** – Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route \- we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.  

  



If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  

  

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.  



**WHO WE ARE?**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

Accrete is an agentic managed services company: an AI workforce that does high\-stakes, judgement\-heavy work for government and enterprise clients — at the economics of software, not labor.


At the core is Accrete’s Knowledge Engine, a dynamic context graph that captures an organization’s tacit knowledge, resolves data across silos, and builds a living, auditable ground truth. Expert agents reason against that ground truth to act on complex, high\-stakes decisions — not just answer questions about them.


From national security to commercial operations, Accrete delivers the work on one platform, with unlimited expert agents and expert judgement.


**About the Role**


We are seeking a **Business Development Lead** to establish and grow Accrete’s presence in the **India market**. You will open doors at India’s leading technology companies and global system integrators and build the relationships, partnerships, and pipeline that bring Accrete’s Knowledge Engine and agentic products to enterprise clients.


This is a **hands\-on, high\-ownership role**. You will act as Accrete’s on\-the\-ground voice in India: shaping our go\-to\-market approach, leveraging your network to secure senior\-level access, and taking deals and partnerships from first conversation to close. You will work closely with Accrete’s leadership, product, and engineering teams to turn market conversations into revenue and lasting strategic relationships.


**What You'll Do**


**Market Entry \& Strategy**


* Define and execute Accrete’s India go\-to\-market strategy, including priority accounts, segments, and use cases for the Knowledge Engine and agentic products.
* Map the India enterprise technology landscape \- IT services and consulting firms, technology companies, and large enterprises across industries\- and identify the sectors and use cases where Accrete can create the most impact.
* Track competitors, pricing, buying patterns, and regulatory considerations (such as data residency and privacy requirements) and feed insights back to leadership.
* Build India\-specific sales playbooks, positioning, and collateral in partnership with Accrete’s product and marketing teams.

**Relationships \& Strategic Partnerships**


* Leverage your existing network to secure introductions and build trusted relationships with senior decision\-makers — CXOs, Heads of AI, Digital, Innovation, Delivery, and Alliances \- at leading Indian technology companies.
* Identify, negotiate, and manage strategic partnerships with IT technology/services firms and system integrators, including co\-sell, referral, reseller, and co\-delivery models.
* Represent Accrete at industry events, forums, and ecosystem engagements to build brand awareness and credibility in India.
* Nurture long\-term executive relationships that lead to repeat business and expanded engagements.

**Pipeline \& Deal Ownership**


* Generate, qualify, and grow a healthy enterprise pipeline through outbound outreach, partner channels, and referrals.
* Own the full sales cycle for complex, long\-cycle enterprise deals, from first meeting through proposal, negotiation, and closure.
* Lead pitches, product demos, and executive briefings that clearly articulate Accrete’s value \- context\-grounded, governed, expert AI agents for high\-stakes work.
* Structure commercial proposals and partnership terms, and work with Accrete’s legal and finance teams to close deals.
* Maintain accurate pipeline tracking, forecasting, and reporting in the CRM.

**Collaboration**


* Partner with product and engineering to share market and customer feedback and shape integration and localization priorities.
* Work with solutions and delivery teams to scope and run proofs of concept and pilots that convert into long\-term engagements.
* Coordinate closely with Accrete’s leadership team across time zones to align priorities and share progress.
* Own initiatives from **market entry and relationship\-building through deal closure and account expansion**.

**Education \& Experience**


* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; an MBA from a reputed institution is preferred.
* **10\+ years of experience in B2B technology business development, enterprise sales, or strategic alliances**, with a strong track record in the India market.
* Proven experience closing enterprise deals and/or partnerships with large IT services companies, system integrators, or large enterprises in India.
* **An established network of senior decision\-makers** at leading Indian technology companies and IT services firms.
* Experience selling complex technical products \- AI/ML, data platforms, cloud, or enterprise software \- to both technical and business stakeholders.

**Skills \& Expertise**


* Strong technical fluency in **AI, LLMs, agentic systems, data platforms, APIs, and cloud** \- enough to hold credible conversations with CTOs, CDOs, and architects.
* Consultative and solution\-selling skills, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes.
* Experience navigating partner onboarding, vendor empanelment, and procurement processes at IT services companies and enterprises.
* Strong commercial acumen, including deal structuring, pricing, partnership economics, and contract negotiation.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and executive\-presence skills; fluent in English.
* Hands\-on experience with CRM tools such as **Salesforce or HubSpot**.

**Leadership \& Working Style**


* Self\-starter who thrives in ambiguous, early\-stage market environments and can operate independently.
* Strong ownership and accountability for pipeline, revenue, and partnership outcomes.
* Comfortable working across time zones with a globally distributed team.
* High integrity, credibility, and a track record of building trust with senior stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and leadership teams.

**Nice to Have**


* Prior experience at an AI, data, or enterprise software company, or in an alliances/partnerships role at a global IT technology/service firm.
* Experience building a market presence in India for a global product or technology company.
* Experience with channel, co\-sell, or marketplace go\-to\-market motions.
* Exposure to regulated industries or selling into environments with strict security, compliance, and data\-sovereignty requirements.
* Working knowledge of Generative AI, AI agents, or knowledge graph technologies.

**Cultural Fit \& Values**


At Accrete, success goes beyond technical expertise. We value:


* **Ownership \& Accountability:** Drive initiatives to completion with high standards and proactive problem\-solving.
* **Transparency \& Communication:** Share information openly and give and receive constructive feedback.
* **Strategic Thinking \& Problem\-Solving:** Analyze challenges critically and develop effective, scalable solutions.
* **Collaboration \& Professionalism:** Work effectively across teams and contribute to a culture of mutual respect.
* **Passion for AI \& Innovation:** Stay curious, continuously learn, and push the boundaries of AI.
* **Going Beyond the Job Description:** Look for opportunities to create impact beyond your immediate responsibilities.

These principles shape our culture, performance expectations, and growth opportunities.

### **Description**

  

We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.  

  

This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Delivery \& stakeholder ownership** — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* **Hands\-on technical leadership \& design** — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* **Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence** — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* **AI\-assisted engineering** — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* **SE \+ SQE leadership** — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* **People management \& culture** — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 **Essential Skills \& Experience*** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don't, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.

title: Senior Clinical Research Associate I
description:
The Senior Clinical Research Associate I is responsible for the site management, site monitoring and close\-out of assigned clinical trials investigator sites to ensure patient safety and quality study execution in accordance with applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards.


The Senior Clinical Research Associate I role is accountable for site management and monitoring, managing investigator site relationships to ensure effective delivery of clinical trials (e.g. enrollment, database release), to safeguard the quality of investigator sites (e.g. patient safety, site quality and compliance with GCP), to maintain investigator and site staff engagement and satisfaction, and to enhance the company’s image with its external stakeholders.


The Senior Clinical Research Associate I is responsible for the resolution of all protocol\-related issues for assigned investigator sites and will work closely with the Site Care Partner, and other members of the study team, as required, in activities associated with the set\-up, running and close out of sites in a clinical trial.

**Job Description:**


Responsible for investigator site management and monitoring for assigned sites: Clinical Trial Monitoring:

* Ensure proper conduct of clinical trials in accordance with the Study Monitoring Plan and


applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards to achieve project goals, timelines and quality.


Manage assigned operational aspects for implementation of clinical trial activities at assigned investigator sites from site initiation through to database lock, ensuring relevant timelines and quality deliverables are met

* During study conduct, serve as the primary point of contact for assigned investigator sites. Work in partnership with and/or escalate to the SCP to ensure quality of site delivery
* Interface with the study team as needed, facilitate information flow between members of the study team, vendors and assigned investigator sites
* Partner with SCP to perform investigator site development, coaching and training of site personnel to ensure ongoing compliance with protocol and the safeguarding of patients; provide protocol training to, and address protocol related questions from the investigator site staff when required, including discussions on known/anticipated operational and clinical trial risks
* Attend investigator meetings when required (virtual or F2F).
* Provide enrollment support and ensure progress by responding to site activation and recruitment issues from investigators. Partner with SCP and the study team to define and support recruitment initiatives at site level
* Conduct onsite, remote/electronic monitoring as needed for study site initiation, routine monitoring and study site closure activities and ensure these are conducted accordance to the Study Monitoring Plan, SOPs and commensurate with emerging issues and technologies.
* Monitor site level AEs and SAEs and collaborate with the Drug Safety Unit and follow\-up with investigators sites, as needed, to bring SAE reports required information to resolution
* Submit all required reports, documentation, updates and tracking within required timeframes, including but not limited to Trial Master File documentation, site reports, site follow up letters, protocol deviations, patient recruitment, clinical supply management, study progress and metrics
* Identify and resolve investigator site issues within required timeframes; agree and develop corrective and preventative actions with investigator and site personnel to close open issues and to prevent recurrence/persistence of issues
* Resolve data queries within required timelines, prepare investigator site close\-out plan and conduct close\-out activities within required timelines
* Ensures adequate oversight of the investigational product at the investigator site, including receipt, handling, accounting, storage conditions, and destruction activities.
* Support database release as needed
* May undertake the responsibilities of an unblinded monitor where required.


Clinical/Scientific and Site Monitoring Risk:

* Maintain thorough understanding of the product, protocol and therapy area in sufficient details to have appropriate discussions with the investigator and site team
* Interact with investigator site heath care professionals in a manner which enhances Pfizer’s credibility, scientific leadership and in order to facilitate Pfizer’s clinical development goals
* Support the study clinician in ensuring patient safety, eligibility and providing clinical guidance to investigators
* Drive Quality Event remediation, when applicable
* Serve as a point of contact for audit conduct, and drive Audit Observation CAPA development and checks, when applicable.
* Mentor/train Clinical Research Associates as assigned
* Serve as an SME for CRA\-related processes
* Participate in regional or local working groups/process improvement initiatives
* Perform activities under guidance of a Site Care Partner prior to site activation e.g. feasibility and site


selection, PTA, coordination of site activation checklist items, ICD finalization, SIV (as applicable),


including management of issues that may compromise time to site activation

* Conduct co\-monitoring activities as requested.

**Qualifications:**

**Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or professional degree in life sciences such as nursing, pharmacy, medical background or equivalent**

* **Monitoring Experience: Minimum 3 years relevant experience in Clinical Research site monitoring (preferably 2 years in Oncology)**

**Extensive knowledge of clinical trial methodologies, ICH/GCP, FDA and local country regulations**

* Preferred therapeutic experience in Oncology, Vaccines, Internal Medicine or Infectious Diseases
* Global clinical trial experience
* Must be fluent in English and in the native language(s) of the country they will work in.

**Physical/ Mental Requirements:**


Advanced knowledge of clinical research and development processes and ability to gain command of process details

* Demonstrated knowledge of global and local regulatory requirements
* Advanced understanding of key operational elements of clinical research (e.g., monitoring, data acquisition and cleaning, reporting, etc.)
* Advanced knowledge in disease and technical areas pertaining to clinical studies, including knowledge of company direction, investigational product(s), and associated development plan(s)
* Demonstrated ability to support sponsor regulatory interactions/inspections
* Demonstrated knowledge of the processes around protocol design and feasibility assessment
* Demonstrated understanding of region/country, culture, and medical practice and how they affect clinical trial delivery
* Proven ability to work in a matrix team environment with the ability to influence, drive / lead and work through others for successful delivery of clinical trial
* Proven ability to evaluate, interpret and present complex issues and data to support risk management and mitigation
* Effective verbal and written communication skills in relating to colleagues and associates both inside and outside of the organization.

**Travel Requirements/ Non\-Standard Work Requirements:**
